in_sanskrit.name: ज्ञान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jñāna (Sanskrit: ज्ञान, IAST: jñāna) is a term in Indian philosophy and religion that refers to knowledge or wisdom, especially knowledge that is spiritual or transcendent. It is often used to refer to the realization of the ultimate truth or reality, and is considered a means to attain moksha (liberation).

in_hindi.name: ज्ञान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज्ञान (Hindi: ज्ञान, IAST: jñāna) is a term that can be translated to English as 'knowledge', 'wisdom', or 'scholarship'. In the context of Indian philosophy and religion, it often refers to the realization of the ultimate truth or reality, and is considered a means to attain moksha (liberation). In common usage, it can also refer to a person who is knowledgeable or scholarly.
